description: Accounting and finance policy presets. Every command that applies a convention states which preset it used. These are configuration inputs, not advice: confirm them with the entity's accountant before publication.

generic_accrual.sign_convention: debit positive, credit negative for asset/expense types; flipped for liability/equity/revenue

ifrs_ifrs16.discounting: incremental borrowing rate by currency and term
required_notes: lease liabilities discounted at the disclosed IBR

tax.note: Rates and thresholds must be confirmed against current BIR issuances; this preset does not constitute tax advice.

required_notes: cash basis stated on the report

journal_rules.posting_is_out_of_scope: This Skill Tool validates and reports; it never posts to a ledger.

statement_rules.income_statement: revenue positive; costs positive; net = revenue - costs - tax
statement_rules.balance_sheet: assets positive; liabilities and equity as credit balances; must balance to tolerance
statement_rules.cash_flow: outflows negative; capex entered positive then subtracted; closing cash must tie to the balance sheet

review_triggers: unmapped accounts in a statement mapping
material variances above the materiality threshold
round-sum or repeated amounts in a journal batch
new vendor, changed bank details, or duplicate invoice candidate
